title: Captured-surface manifest
description: Per-repo record of which UI surfaces the scoring programme covers and which of them have actually been observed. Documentation of the SHAPE only. It is deliberately NOT the gate: a schema cannot express 'required but never captured', 'reason is a placeholder', or 'this capture measured a login redirect'. derive-captured-surfaces.mjs is the authority and validates the parsed value at runtime; a manifest that satisfies this schema can still fail the gate, and that is the point.

livenessContract.description: Whether capture records must carry liveness evidence. There is no warn-only mode and no default: an absent declaration is a gate failure.

oneOf.description: Every capture record must carry a valid `liveness` block.

issue.description: #issue, a URL, or a 40-hex commit, so an unproven capture programme cannot go quiet.

liveness.description: Per-repo liveness thresholds. A repo may RAISE these; the gate clamps any attempt to lower them below the canonical floor (minElements 100, minTextLength 200).

derivation.description: How routes are derived. May also live in docs/captured-surfaces.config.json, which wins.

appDirs.description: Repo-relative App Router roots, e.g. ["src/app"] or ["apps/dashboard/src/app"].

dynamicExpansions.description: Maps a dynamic pattern to the concrete values it resolves to, e.g. {"/workspace/[slug]": ["memsys", "asimtop"]}. A pattern with no expansion is KEPT as a pattern and still demands a decision.

maxDepth.description: Bounded on purpose: unbounded recursive scans have frozen this host for hours.

capture.description: required = in the scoring programme, and must carry `capturedAt` or a tracked `captureDeferred`. excluded = deliberately outside it, and must carry `reason` + `excludedBy`.

reason.description: Mandatory for `excluded`. Minimum 20 chars, placeholders rejected.

probeUrl.description: For a dynamic pattern: the concrete URL the probe should load.

commit.description: Full sha. A short sha is ambiguous and cannot be checked against a remote.

viewports.description: Must cover every label the manifest declares.

method.description: A capture with no named method cannot be reproduced, so it is not evidence.

concreteUrl.description: Mandatory when `route` is a dynamic pattern: /reports/[token] cannot be visited.

liveness.description: Proof the capture observed the app rather than a socket, a redirect, or a loading state. Mandatory under livenessContract v1.

httpStatus.description: A listening port is not a served app: content-factory answered 500 on a live socket for a whole scoring round.

finalPath.description: Where the browser ended up. Must equal the requested path, or the capture measured a redirect target.

elementCount.description: DOM elements under body. A fleet login page measured ~78.
